summary: This is a Form 6-K by Concorde International Group Ltd., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, reporting receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. No transaction, merger, tender offer, or corporate action is described. The filing merely discloses the non-compliance under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) and outlines the 180-day cure period through December 28, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, price terms, or structural mechanics are mentioned. The sole event is an exchange-mandated notification, not a special situation; the company may face delisting risk if it fails to regain compliance within the period.
